stops.name: Gollinger Wasserfall
stops.detail: The Gollinger Waterfall, actually called Schwarzbachfall or Schwarzenbachfall, is a waterfall located in the Tennengau (Austria) on the municipal border between Golling on the Salzach and Kuchl. The drop height of the water is around 100 meters, the water comes directly from the Schwarzbachfall cave.
